DOES NOT REPRODUCE. Paper reports 93% of subjects with a positive TE under positive information (BART). The deposited script, run with a seed prepended as its only modification, gives 0.990; the maintained rewrite gives 0.990. A ten-seed sweep (maintained/output/text_bart_seed_sensitivity.csv) shows 0.93 lies below every run, so this is not seed noise. The error understates the paper own result: a higher share correctly signed is stronger evidence of homogeneity, so the substantive claim is unaffected. Candidate explanation: the archive was deposited 2018-06-27 when dbarts 0.9-3 was current, and dbarts NEWS records four later fixes to multithreaded sampling (race conditions in 0.9-18, reproducibility in 0.9-19, k mixing across chains in 0.9-20, inconsistent results in 0.9-23). The deposited script sets no seed and pins no threads, so package changes may account for the gap rather than anything in the analysis. Untested; would require installing 0.9-3 under the R of the day.
